summary: WhatsApp native Confirm/Edit/Cancel review for stock_receive, payment_record, product_price_update and order_attachment_add (Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations scenes w-recv, w-pay, w-price, batch-stock, fl-recv, fl-unit). The four actions join nativeWhatsAppReviewActions and their manifest WhatsApp mode becomes native; capability rollout and whatsapp.rollout stay source, so native review still needs whatsAppCapabilityEnabled (local source or the released capability list). Strict per-action guards in channel-proposal-review prove the review shows every effect: stock quantity, entered unit and factor, on hand before → after, source, reason, supplier, effective time and cost; payment order, amount and method, receiving account and balance after; price old → new, reason and all-Store scope; order attachment order, file or note and that order items, totals and payments stay unchanged. Anything incomplete, clipped or differently shaped falls back to app/web review. The WhatsApp stock form drafts a proposal when stock_receive is native-reviewable and keeps the app handoff otherwise. Money receipts never say sent, moved or transferred. Planned reports gain a verified report-page deep-link helper (wiring pending). Local only; no deployment. Coordinator gate added before commit: these four native reviews are off everywhere until named in ASSISTANT_WHATSAPP_NATIVE_REVIEW_ACTIONS (comma list of action names, default empty), enforced in whatsAppCapabilityEnabled, so a capability released for web review never switches to chat confirmation on deploy; web review and app handoff stay exactly as before.

capabilities.note: WhatsApp mode app_review → native; rollout fields unchanged. Same canonical adapter, roles and confirmation; chat review only when released.
WhatsApp mode app_review → native; rollout fields unchanged. Native review requires a named receiving account; records money already received.
WhatsApp mode app_review → native; rollout fields unchanged. Review shows old → new price and that it applies in every Store.
WhatsApp mode app_review → native; rollout fields unchanged. Review names the order and the note or sent file; the order itself is unchanged.

evidence.result: 8 pass, 60 expects. Payment, price and order attachment reviews come from the real adapters with stubbed reads; stock receipt mirrors its adapter lines. Missing or altered facts fall back to app review.
6 pass, 80 expects: native list, app-review list and production release gate.
2 pass: receipts and the money wording guard.
Pass: report deep links only to /finance/reports, /customer-ledger and /inventory.
